background: Bank of America, N.A. is the main deposit-taking bank of Bank of America Corporation, the second-largest US bank by assets, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: The operating bank carries the group's highest ratings: AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook, though the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 19 May 2025. Capital is strong for a US bank, with CET1 of 12.1% at the peer median and leverage of 7.1% in the top quarter. Liquidity is the softer side: LCR of 112% is below the peer median, and CET1 has fallen 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, the one trend to watch. Nothing flagged in the last 90 days.
